doc: metrics.measure on a map: global_mean, zonal profile (5-degree bands: centers and means), area-weighted 10-bin histogram, the 56 gnomonic patches (patches) each measured by coherence, spectral_slope and object_stats, then coherence and spectral_slope = mean over patches (np.nanmean for the slope: NaN patches are skipped), coherence_by_lat = mean over the 8 longitudes of each of the 7 latitudes (PATCH_LATS order), big_object_share = mean of the per-patch shares, median_object_km2 = np.median over the 56 per-patch medians (even count: mean of the middle two), seam_ratio, pole_std. Extra outputs patch_coherence, patch_slope, patch_big, patch_median are the 56 per-patch values (patches order: latitude-major) recomputed by the case through the same calls, to localize a difference. A cloudless 64x32 map (all 0): every patch is flat, so spectral_slope is NaN (np.nanmean of an empty selection, with a warning), coherence 0, no objects (big share 0, median 0), seam_ratio 0 / 1e-12 = 0, pole_std (0, 0), the histogram all in the first bin. A flat patch (every texel exactly 0) has no power: its spectral slope is NaN, np.nanmean skips it, its coherence and objects are 0.  Input convention: the u8 input(s) img are maps stored as bytes, and the function receives them as float32(u8) / float32(255) (`u8.astype(np.float32) / 255.0`: the division is done, and correctly rounded, in float32, as measure.load reads an 8-bit map), NOT as the raw bytes and NOT as a float64 quotient (a texel on a histogram edge or a threshold would move). params.u8_inputs lists them.

params.input: u8 / 255 as float32 (the 8-bit map measure.py loads)

u8_inputs.img: float32(u8) / float32(255), the division in float32
